title: False-pass rate alone is not accepted-product purity
statement: With bad-pass probability 0.001, good-pass probability 0.999 and incoming bad fraction pi, the bad fraction among passes is pi*0.001/[pi*0.001+(1-pi)*0.999]. For pi=0.1, 0.99 and 0.9999 it is about 0.0001112, 0.09016 and 0.90917. A false-pass number is therefore not accepted-product purity without the input mixture, rejected stock, useful yield and reset costs.
